name: Fateline
source:
As children, we looked up at the stars and had our first thoughts about the universe. Thousands of years of accumulated knowledge into the mind, the truth of the world began to appear before our eyes. This is a story about small love in the context of the world.

Time is too fast, so fast that we know each other but have no time to say an I love you.

[Edited from [url=https://www.taptap.com/app/136751]TapTap[/url]]
translation:
小时候，我们仰望星空，第一次开始思考宇宙。数千年积累的知识流入脑海，世界的真相渐渐展现在眼前。这是一个在世界的宏大背景下关于渺小爱情的故事。

时光太快，快到我们相识，却来不及说一句我爱你。

[编译自[url=https://www.taptap.com/app/136751]TapTap[/url]]
